messages:
DeployBot: PROD deploy initiated for production/us-west-2 — tag=v3.6.0 commit=`ab12cd34`. initiated_by=alex. plan: canary -> gradual shift -> 100%. estimated rollout ~10m. safeguards: autofallback to v3.5.2 if >2% errors for 2m.
alex: kicking off cutover. starting canary (5% traffic) now. will monitor dashboards.
sam: standing by on telemetry (p50/p95/p99, 5xx, error-rate). will call rollback if >5% relative error increase sustained for 3m.
nisha: infra smoke checks running: `kubectl -n inference get pods | grep v3-6` -> all Ready. health probes passing.
ci-cd-bot: CI pipelines green, artifact uploaded: s3://releases/v3.6.0/artifact.tar.gz. release notes draft: https://go/release/v3.6.0
leila: QA smoke on canary completed, no regressions in reranking evals. sample prompts validated.
alex: shifting to 25% now. minimal ramp to validate throughput.
DeployBot: traffic shifted to 25% (canary-id=can-8712). Monitoring hooks active. initial metrics: latency +1%, errors +0.2% (baseline).
sam: p99 and error budget look stable so far. nothing blocking.
nisha: autoscaler engaged; observed CPU/GPU utilization +6% on model hosts, within expected range.
alex: pinning `ab12cd34` to production tag now.
DeployBot: production tag pin complete. will proceed with gradual shift to 100% over next 10m.
leila: quick note — tokenization tweak causes minor diff on very long prompts, validated as nonblocking.
sam: acknowledged, won't block rollout. keeping extra vigilance on inference errors.
DeployBot: traffic shift 100% complete. rollout_id=rb-20260401-7, duration=9m23s, commit=`ab12cd34`. Observability: health checks green, error_rate delta +0.3%, latency within SLOs.
alex: excellent. posting summary to #prod-updates and release tracker.
ci-cd-bot: release notes live: https://go/release/v3.6.0/notes. changelog includes: improved kv-cache handling, kernel selection tweak, and minor tokenizer adjustment.
nisha: resource footprint up ~8% on model nodes; autoscaler stabilized pod counts. no action required.
DeployBot: final status: SUCCESS. closing thread.
alex: great work team :tada:
sam: keeping on-call watch open for 60m for post-cutover telemetry.
leila: will run a short regression sweep in 30m and report back.
thread_text_summary: DeployBot announced production rollout of v3.6.0 (commit ab12cd34). Team ran canary -> gradual shift to 100%, smoke tests and QA passed, autoscaler handled additional load, minor tokenizer diff noted but nonblocking. Rollout completed successfully and tag pinned. On-call remains monitoring for 1h.
